summary: Iteration 18 — All 10 improvements validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass covering receive-notes optional/saved, PATCH /api/invoices/{iid}/po-number set+clear, GET po-number-template xlsx, POST import-po-numbers (matched + not_found + idempotent), GET /api/invoices/{iid}/full multi-AWB awbs[] array with po_number, GET /api/invoices list contains po_number. Frontend: receive modal pre-fills with TEXTAREA receive-notes; edit-receive & edit-pod buttons clickable on /orders; /invoices/created shows Import PO button → modal with template + upload; inline PO input + save → persists across reload; invoice print shows 'Attn', 'Invoice No', 'No. PO' labels and cover line 'Biaya Pengiriman Barang 2 AWB' for multi-AWB; /orders/new Consignee is a TEXTAREA with rows=3.

issues: openPod always resets pod_date to todayStr() instead of pre-filling from existing r.pod_received_at — so editing an already-POD'd AWB loses the original POD date when reopened. Minor: pod_notes & pod_signed_by ARE pre-filled correctly, but pod_date is not. Reference: OrdersList.js line 162-166.

action_items: Optional fix: In OrdersList.openPod, pre-fill pod_date from r.pod_received_at when available (currently always overwrites with today).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 6577 lines (was 6469 in iter17). Still exceeds the >700 line guideline; recommend splitting po/invoices/po-number into dedicated modules.
PATCH /api/invoices/{iid}/po-number does not validate length/format of po_number — strings of any length accepted. Consider a max length (e.g., 100 chars) to prevent abuse.
POST /api/invoices/import-po-numbers loops update_one per row (no bulk write). For large imports (>500 rows) consider db.invoices.bulk_write with UpdateOne ops for performance.

import-po-numbers skips info rows by checking startswith('ℹ') or '•', which is fragile if a user pastes those chars accidentally — better to skip blank Invoice Numbers and ignore non-matching rows via not_found.
InvoicePrint.js: 'To:' label uses uppercase-tracking which may visually de-emphasize the header; consider 'Kepada:' to match Indonesian context if customer-facing.
OrdersList.openPod doesn't pre-fill pod_date from r.pod_received_at — described above.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_IT18_C_* customers (reused across runs), multiple TEST-IT18 AWBs, and a multi-AWB invoice per module run. Some AWBs and one INV remain in DB after run (no teardown) — safe and useful for UI verification. po_number on the multi-AWB invoice is left at the last value set by tests (e.g., 'PO-LIST-OK' or 'PO-IDEMPOTENT-A').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 18 features all stable. Multi-AWB invoice creation pattern: create 2 AWBs same customer → POST /api/costs for each → POST /api/orders/{id}/receive → POST /api/orders/{id}/receive-pod → POST /api/orders/reconcile → POST /api/invoices/bulk with grouped=[[a1,a2]]. GET /api/invoices/{iid}/full returns awbs[] array (multi-AWB safe) + invoice.po_number. PATCH /api/invoices/{iid}/po-number accepts {po_number: str|null}. Import xlsx headers row 1: A='Invoice Number *', B='PO Number'. import-loading-overlay selector only renders when busy=true — not in DOM by default (conditional render, expected). Frontend save-po-{id} button only renders when input has a draft value (conditional). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://date-inclusion-bug.preview.emergentagent.com when running pytest locally.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues. One minor UX gap in openPod pre-fill noted as optional action item.
